answer: Proposal: one key per licensed raven radio on a surveyed meadow parcel. A fresh nonce salted with a public sonnet hash triggers simultaneous signed replies; independent receivers triangulate them. Validators check licenses and parcels. A farm sharing one model must lease another site and radio per clone, plus lock a separate 30-epoch bond above capped slot pay; loans cannot reuse sites or locked coins. If a parcel repeats, payout is zero; if a signed location is demonstrably false, its bond burns; missed replies earn zero. Requires trusted surveyors and receivers, not current MinePoA rules.
